chunks: Thus it was; and We passed them on to another people.

key_terms.أَوْرَثْنَاهَا: We caused them to inherit it

ai.seo_question: Who inherited the land after the people of Muhammad (AS) rejected him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a divine transition of spiritual and temporal authority from the previous generation to the Quraysh, and ultimately to the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing the continuity of prophetic legacy. The 'other people' are seen not merely as a new tribe but as the chosen vessel for the final message, linking the historical conquest of Mecca to the eschatological role of the Imams. This transfer underscores the concept of divine election (Istifa) and the preservation of the message through a specific lineage.
